function.name: get_services
function.description: Lists all known services with their criticality tier (critical/medium/low) and owning team.

function.name: get_metrics_for_service
function.description: Returns near-real-time metrics (p99 latency ms, error rate, CPU percent, timestamp) for one service, oldest first.

function.name: get_logs_for_service
function.description: Returns legacy log-export rows for one service (batch-based, not real-time). Uses svc_name and a date string (MM/DD/YYYY) — different field names than the metrics source.

svc_name.description: Service name as recorded in the legacy log export

function.name: get_incidents_for_service
function.description: Returns known incidents for one service, most recent first.

function.name: get_incident_updates
function.description: Returns status updates already posted for one incident, oldest first.

function.name: get_remediation_log_for_service
function.description: Returns remediation actions already taken for one service, most recent first.

function.name: search_runbooks
function.description: Keyword-searches the runbook knowledge base and returns matching docs ranked by relevance, each with a preview snippet.

query.description: Free-text symptoms/keywords, e.g. 'connection pool exhausted payment-gateway timeout'

function.name: execute_remediation
function.description: Executes a remediation action against a service and logs it. Skeleton only — not yet gated by a permission/risk-tier guardrail layer.

function.name: post_incident_update
function.description: Posts a human-readable status update against an incident.
